response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems expertise with exposure to event-driven architectures and AI-agent tooling, but lacks direct executive leadership experience in fintech or regulated environments. His background in agentic frameworks and real-time systems is promising, though not explicitly tied to financial applications or multi-agent AI production deployments at scale.
strengths: Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators, agentic workflows at re:cinq).
Proven track record in distributed systems and real-time data processing (e.g., low-latency apps at Sociomantic, event-driven platforms at GISCollective).
Strong engineering craftsmanship with a focus on testability, observability, and tooling (e.g., Fluent-Asserts, Trial test runner).
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience (e.g., scaling teams from 10 to 30+ or owning CTO-level responsibilities).
Limited fintech-specific expertise (e.g., credit systems, regulatory compliance, or algorithmic working-capital management).
Agentic AI experience appears more prototypical (e.g., tooling/frameworks) rather than production deployment in high-stakes environments.
